proposal.summary: Stored cross-site scripting (XSS) in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3 allows an administrative user who can configure settings to inject a script that will execute in the browser of another administrative user.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

AV.quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

PR.quote: If a user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege configures specially crafted settings

C.quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

I.quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the stored XSS by having an administrative user configure crafted settings and observing execution in another admin's browser; if confirmed, identify affected input(s), implement proper output encoding/input validation, and prepare a patch for versions prior to 3.5.3. Notify users to update to 3.5.3 when patched.

evidence_quotes.quote: Cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

evidence_quotes.claim: attacker privileges required to configure crafted settings
